The '''Ber de Val system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" />
It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ber de Val]].
